note: mteb 2.20.5, four native Vietnamese retrieval tasks. Measures the embedding model alone: no chunking, no BM25, no rank fusion, no reranker.

instruction_ablation.what:
Query-side instruction only, in the shape Qwen3-Embedding was trained with (Instruct: {task}
Query: {text}). Documents stay bare, so no re-indexing.
instruction_ablation.caution: A first attempt showed a delta of 0.0002 and nearly concluded instructions do nothing. That run was a no-op: the wrapper only applies an instruction when prompt_dict is not None, so both arms measured the same configuration.
